propositions: Compiled state tracks plan_review_phase (planning|execution) derived from winning status entries: in_progress→execution, open→planning, others preserve, losing events never update

Execution-phase plan reviews enforce fixed 0.80 priority-floor blocking threshold; planning phases use stricter original thresholds; phase_status indicates compatibility/incompatibility/malformed across current and signed phases
Manifest output emits review-phase token and optional priority-floor (0.80 for execution only) in fixed order after advisory; legacy attestations without phase fields parse as planning

Plan review signing transaction captures immutable PlanReviewGeneration before LLM/probe; retries on HEAD instability up to 3 times; stable changes return unsigned stale; under-lock HEAD/generation mismatch retries; no partial writes on failure

Pre-feature snapshots bootstrap phase once from compiled status (open/idea→planning, others→execution) emitting structured INFO log; cache versioning activates lazy bootstrap; field persists through compaction and older-reducer pass-through

Re-sign parses v2 JSON phase fields (lowercase string phase, number floor for execution only) through sidecar parser; refuses incompatible/malformed variants; builds manifest from recorded review-time phase/floor not newly inferred phase
